name_zh: 卡斯特罗/古巴/革命/导弹/医疗/教育/菲德尔/封锁/生存/古巴
core_mode: M611 革命导弹/医疗教育/封锁生存/古巴模式/菲德尔长寿
description_zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗（1926-2016），古巴前总统，1959-2016年在位。他是一位古巴政治家，前游击战士，通过领导古巴革命推翻了巴蒂斯塔政权。卡斯特罗是革命的领导者之一，提出了社会主义制度和全民医疗教育。他的统治时期，古巴经历了导弹危机和美国封锁，但也实现了医疗和教育事业的发展。他的长期统治对古巴产生了深远的影响。
description_en: Fidel Castro (1926-2016), former President of Cuba, served from 1959 to 2016. He was a Cuban politician and former guerrilla fighter, led Cuban Revolution to overthrow Batista regime. Castro was one of the leaders of the revolution, proposed socialist system and universal medical education. His rule period, Cuba experienced missile crisis and US blockade, but also achieved development in medical and educational undertakings. His long-term rule had profound impact on Cuba.
